steps.text: The previously launched generation is displayed with a green dot indicating it completed successfully. Expand it to access the generated keys.
steps.title: Generation completed

steps.text: Click the generation to show the keys it produced.
steps.title: Expand the generation

steps.text: The keys computed by OLAGSA are listed under the generation. Each key can be viewed, saved, or deleted individually.
steps.title: Allocation keys available

steps.text: Click a key to show its allocation.
steps.title: Expand the key

steps.text: The key's allocation table is displayed. The delete button (×) at the top right of the row allows permanently deleting this key.
steps.title: Key selected

steps.text: Click the × button on the key to initiate deletion. A confirmation will be required before the key is permanently removed.
steps.title: Delete the key

steps.text: A confirmation dialog appears. Click the confirm button to permanently delete this allocation key.
steps.title: Confirm deletion

steps.text: Confirm your choice in the confirmation dialog.
steps.title: Confirm

steps.text: The key has been permanently deleted. It no longer appears in the generation's results list and cannot be recovered.
steps.title: Key deleted
